No failures relevant to my change, pre-existing warnings only. The fix is complete.

## Summary

The bug was a single off-by-one in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`'s `index()` method: `ListPostsQuerySchema` already validates `page` as 1-based (defaulting to `1`), but the controller was calling `.paginate({ page: page + 1, perPage: 10 })`, shifting every request one page forward — page 1 requested page 2 of data, and the newest 10 posts were permanently unreachable. Fixed by passing `page` through unchanged. I also added a regression test in `tests/PostController.test.ts` that seeds 25 posts and asserts `/posts` (default page) returns the newest 10, with `currentPage: 1` and `from`/`to` of `1`–`10`. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass, and `bunx guren check` shows no new issues.
